m_share_hint: Tip: in any app, tap Share → SecureShare.
m_invalid_code: The code looks like xxxx-xxxx: 8 letters and digits.
m_open_failed: No app can open this file.
m_resume_hint_send: To continue, send the same file again — the receiver only downloads what is missing (within 7 days).
m_resume_hint_receive: What was received is saved. Ask the sender to send the same file again and enter the new code — the transfer continues where it stopped.
m_notif_verify: Open the app and compare the verification code
m_storage_denied: Without storage permission the file cannot be saved to Downloads.
m_compat: Works with SecureShare 4.x on a computer.
m_help_send_body:
1.  On the Send tab, tap “Choose file”
2.  Tap “Send” — a session code appears
3.  Give the code to the recipient (the Share button helps)
4.  Compare the verification code and tap “Codes match”

You can also send from another app: Share → SecureShare.
m_help_recv_body:
1.  On the Receive tab, enter the code from the sender
2.  Tap “Receive”
3.  Compare the verification code and tap “Codes match”

Files are saved to Download/SecureShare. An existing file is never overwritten — the new one is saved as “name (1).ext”.
m_help_background_body:
The transfer continues with the screen off or another app open: progress is shown in a notification, where you can also cancel it.

If the phone still stops the transfer (battery saver), start it again with a new code — what was already transferred is not sent twice.
